messages:
ana: FYI PR #4122 preview failed CI: md-lint and linkcheck. Quick scan shows two linkcheck failures (internal anchors) and one md-lint line-length in examples/snippets/quickstart.md.

ci-bot: Linkcheck: 2 broken anchors in examples/snippets/quickstart.md -> #setup and #auth.
md-lint: line length 121 > 100 at examples/snippets/quickstart.md:42

devon: I renamed a heading earlier, must've broken #setup. I'll revert the heading slug or add redirect anchors.

lucas: For the long line, we can break the code comment into two lines. It's just a sample.

ana: Can we get this in before Wednesday doc freeze? Small fixes only. If fixes are trivial, I can approve and merge in the emergency window.

devon: I'll push a small commit to restore the heading and add a short anchor alias for compatibility.

lucas: Pushed fix for line wrap and updated the code block to comply with md-lint. Also added `<!-- md-lint-disable -->` inline around one generated table that is hard to wrap.

ci-bot: Preview rerun: linkcheck -> PASS; md-lint -> PASS. Automatic note: please avoid disabling md-lint unless unavoidable.

tara: Thanks! I'll review and merge during the Wed emergency slot at 16:30 UTC if no objections.

ana: Approving now. Minor changelog entry requested.

ci-bot: Merge performed at 16:35 UTC. Thread closed.
